main_text.p: Partis hujus primæ, de Idololatrica Invocatione pontificia, duo membra cõstituemus. Horum unum erit, Enarratio præcepti primi & secundi, inq; primis de cultu & invocatione Sanctorum, ac de statuis & imaginibus : alterum, de salutatione Angelica, quam velut precationem Jesuitæ affluunt Orationi dominicæ.
Ex his pius lector nullo negotio cognoscere poterit, quàm graviter ab adversariis in primum Christianæ Religionis atq; etiam tertium caput, Decalogum inquam & Dominicam precationem, impingatur.

page.notes: Scan is slightly blurred at the lower part of the page; the lower faint text (show-through from the reverse side) was not transcribed. The signature "A 4" at the foot is partly visible and read from the scan.
